```wolfram
(* Run UUIDv7: 01a099c9-f57c-7626-a7bc-f940f1394cee.
   Machine contract: sourceRead -> requirementsCompared -> resultReturned.
   No filesystem operations. Lean some .stage maps to "stage"; none to "none". *)
ClearAll["Global`*"];
runIdentifier = "01a099c9-f57c-7626-a7bc-f940f1394cee";
utcTime[] := DateString[{"ISODate", "T", "Hour", ":", "Minute", ":", "Second", "Z"}, TimeZone -> 0];
startedAtUtc = utcTime[];
stages = {"source", "optimized", "validated", "shipped", "rejected"};
events = {"optimize", "validate", "ship", "reject"};
modes = {"staticExport", "serverRuntime"};
placements = {"server", "client"};
capabilities = {"pureRendering", "serverOnly", "browserApi", "state", "eventHandler", "threeDimensionalRendering"};

(* Current Model.lean lines 131-145, 195-200, 210-218: literal branch translations. *)
transitionImplementation[stage_, event_] := Switch[stage,
  "source", Switch[event, "optimize", "optimized", "reject", "rejected", "validate" | "ship", "none"],
  "optimized", Switch[event, "validate", "validated", "reject", "rejected", "optimize" | "ship", "none"],
  "validated", Switch[event, "ship", "shipped", "reject", "rejected", "optimize" | "validate", "none"],
  "shipped" | "rejected", "none"];
deploymentImplementation[mode_, capability_] := Switch[mode,
  "staticExport", Switch[capability, "serverOnly", False,
    "pureRendering" | "browserApi" | "state" | "eventHandler" | "threeDimensionalRendering", True],
  "serverRuntime", True];
placementImplementation[placement_, capability_] := Switch[capability,
  "pureRendering", True,
  "serverOnly", Switch[placement, "server", True, "client", False],
  "browserApi" | "state" | "eventHandler" | "threeDimensionalRendering",
    Switch[placement, "server", False, "client", True]];

(* Independent requirements: spec.md lines 53-68.
   Tests.lean lines 64-70 additionally specify rejection from each unfinished stage.
   Ordered progress permits exactly the event at the current stage index.
   Shipped and rejected are terminal; all other nonprogress events are invalid. *)
stageIndex = AssociationThread[stages -> Range[0, 4]];
eventIndex = AssociationThread[events -> Range[0, 3]];
transitionRequirement[stage_, event_] := Which[
  MemberQ[{"shipped", "rejected"}, stage], "none",
  event === "reject", "rejected",
  Lookup[stageIndex, stage] === Lookup[eventIndex, event],
    stages[[Lookup[stageIndex, stage] + 2]],
  True, "none"];
(* Static export forbids request-time server features.
   Pure rendering is allowed on either side. Server-only features require server;
   browser access, state, handlers and three-dimensional rendering require client. *)
deploymentRequirement[mode_, capability_] :=
  Not[mode === "staticExport" && capability === "serverOnly"];
requiredPlacement = <|"pureRendering" -> {"server", "client"}, "serverOnly" -> {"server"},
  "browserApi" -> {"client"}, "state" -> {"client"}, "eventHandler" -> {"client"},
  "threeDimensionalRendering" -> {"client"}|>;
placementRequirement[placement_, capability_] :=
  MemberQ[Lookup[requiredPlacement, capability], placement];

(* Golden tables freshly read from current Tests.lean lines 64-80. *)
transitionGolden = {{"optimized", "none", "none", "rejected"},
  {"none", "validated", "none", "rejected"}, {"none", "none", "shipped", "rejected"},
  {"none", "none", "none", "none"}, {"none", "none", "none", "none"}};
deploymentGolden = {{True, False, True, True, True, True}, {True, True, True, True, True, True}};
placementGolden = {{True, True, False, False, False, False}, {True, False, True, True, True, True}};

compareEveryInput[name_, claimIdentifier_, rowDomain_, columnDomain_, implementation_, requirement_, golden_] :=
 Module[{inputs, actual, required, expected, records},
  inputs = Tuples[{rowDomain, columnDomain}];
  actual = (implementation @@ # &) /@ inputs;
  required = (requirement @@ # &) /@ inputs;
  expected = Flatten[golden];
  records = MapThread[
    <|"input" -> #1, "implementation" -> #2, "requirement" -> #3, "golden" -> #4,
      "implementationMatchesRequirement" -> SameQ[#2, #3],
      "implementationMatchesGolden" -> SameQ[#2, #4],
      "goldenMatchesRequirement" -> SameQ[#4, #3]|> &,
    {inputs, actual, required, expected}];
  <|"function" -> name, "claimIdentifier" -> claimIdentifier,
    "inputCount" -> Length[inputs], "uniqueInputCount" -> Length[DeleteDuplicates[inputs]],
    "goldenDimensionsMatch" -> SameQ[Dimensions[golden], {Length[rowDomain], Length[columnDomain]}],
    "implementationVersusRequirementsMismatchCount" ->
      Count[Lookup[records, "implementationMatchesRequirement"], False],
    "implementationVersusGoldenMismatchCount" -> Count[Lookup[records, "implementationMatchesGolden"], False],
    "goldenVersusRequirementsMismatchCount" -> Count[Lookup[records, "goldenMatchesRequirement"], False],
    "mismatches" -> Select[records, Not[#["implementationMatchesRequirement"] &&
      #["implementationMatchesGolden"] && #["goldenMatchesRequirement"]] &],
    "actualOutputs" -> Partition[actual, Length[columnDomain]]|>
 ];
comparisons = {
  compareEveryInput["transition", "3994c7e6-6387-590c-9922-3fad04fc482d",
    stages, events, transitionImplementation, transitionRequirement, transitionGolden],
  compareEveryInput["deploymentCapabilityAllowed", "ac27dc88-da25-51f7-8af5-c431e22cd72b",
    modes, capabilities, deploymentImplementation, deploymentRequirement, deploymentGolden],
  compareEveryInput["componentPlacementAllowed", "cf86cf5d-e0c7-58e4-aa77-ae4d0e72bf46",
    placements, capabilities, placementImplementation, placementRequirement, placementGolden]};
ExportString[<|"runIdentifier" -> runIdentifier, "startedAtUtc" -> startedAtUtc,
  "completedAtUtc" -> utcTime[], "comparisonCount" -> Length[comparisons],
  "totalInputCount" -> Total[Lookup[comparisons, "inputCount"]], "comparisons" -> comparisons|>,
  "RawJSON", "Compact" -> True]
```
